MuleSoft, Inc. owns and operates Anypoint Platform, an integration solution for connecting applications, data sources, and devices, both on-premises and in the cloud. The company has market cap of $5.95 billion. The Company’s hybrid integration platform includes iPaaS, ESB, and a unified solution for API management, design, and publishing. It currently has negative earnings. The firm was formerly known as MuleSource Inc. and changed its name to MuleSoft, Inc. in September 2009.
